patterns.name: blank reverse, exact digital front
patterns.recipe: Show the unprinted back of a physical paper item in generated footage. Put all meaningful labels, dates and amounts in authored UI.
patterns.evidence: tuck_receipt_h3max_v1 rejected for text; v2 selected
patterns.limit: Still judge physical proportions; the v2 paper is wider than the requested receipt strip.

patterns.name: single-take human callback
patterns.recipe: Generate a simple action and later withdrawal in one continuous take. Use distinct source ranges around the product walkthrough. Preserve lighting, wardrobe and camera.
patterns.limit: Not evidence for independent multi-shot identity consistency.

patterns.name: flat hand, small action
patterns.recipe: Rest the palm, keep fingers loosely together, slide a light object a short distance, then withdraw. Avoid a sequence of grasping, lifting, rotating and placing.
patterns.evidence: Targeted H3 Max v2; eight-frame sampled review

patterns.name: physical shape becomes product surface
patterns.recipe: Align a blank authored plane with the physical paper, rotate it flat and expand it. Keep it opaque, then introduce exact UI after it settles.
patterns.limit: An editorial shape match, not tracked compositing onto a moving real screen.

patterns.name: finished work beside human exit
patterns.recipe: Keep the completed report readable in one region while a small return shot shows the hand leave. Hold the final result through the CTA.
patterns.limit: Final four seconds of source panel are an explicit freeze.

avoid: A cursor covering numbers being reviewed
No response after a primary action
Claiming a new matching shot when it is a later source range
Treating a mocked report as actual reimbursement approval
